prompt:
This workspace contains a skill project at skill-src/ (SKILL.md plus scripts/ and references/). Do this end to end with the moss CLI ($MOSS_BENCH_CLI holds the dist/cli.js path):

1. Install it into the workspace scope non-interactively:
   node "$MOSS_BENCH_CLI" skill install skill-src --workspace --yes
2. Verify the lockfile:
   node "$MOSS_BENCH_CLI" skill lock --workspace
   It must print a line for bench-install ending in "ok".
3. Prove drift detection: append one line to .moss/skills/bench-install/SKILL.md, run `node "$MOSS_BENCH_CLI" skill lock --workspace` again, and record that it exits 1 and reports DRIFT.
4. Restore the installed tree (reinstall or update with --yes) and run skill lock one final time; it must be back to exit 0 with "ok".

Never execute scripts/run.sh. Do not edit skill-src/. Finish by quoting the final lock line and the drift line verbatim.
